title: Open and work through Messages without a mouse
body: You can now Tab through the conversation list and press Enter or Space to open one — before this, the list only responded to a mouse click, so anyone using a keyboard or a switch device could not open a conversation at all. The row you are on now shows a clear focus outline, the ⋯ menu opens with the keyboard and closes with Escape, and the buttons that show only an icon — mark all as read, new conversation, jump to latest, the ⋯ on each row — now say what they do out loud to a screen reader.
